scenarios.name: Select a staged command with the secondary mouse button

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target
"2D Sketches" has been staged in the target list
the user right-clicks the "2D Sketches" name in the target list
the user clicks the remove command button
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the target retains its pending-change marker
